source_text: The American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) and American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) recommend effective analgesia for all neonatal circumcisions, as newborns have functional pain pathways and experience distress similar to adults, overturning prior misconceptions.
